milestone: WP-01 immutable held-child observations and qualified pane refresh continuity (partial WP-01)
configuration: Release C++20 strict warnings; installed ckVision SDK; Windows static CRT
sanitizer_scope: 10 translation units: native names, basic metadata, directory cursor, opened-entry defaults, channel/limit dependency, held child, pane model, pane tests, continuity tests, ckVision test host. 29 pane/domain continuity cases; all 21 Files CTest suites separately ran on all hosts.
qualified_behaviors: Immutable factory-only HeldChild observations retain parent and child; copy/move construction and assignment are disabled and checked at compile time. Objects are allocated const.

Refresh acquires the same basename from the same held parent, keeps both child handles alive, rechecks the old identity/kind, and creates a later family revision only on qualified Same comparisons. Cached snapshots and independent matching-ID opens cannot transfer continuity.

Unknown identities, all-zero object IDs, kind changes, old-handle query failures and name replacement do not establish continuity. Per-field/native errors remain explicit. Windows successful FileIdInfo with all-zero object ID is Unknown without legacy fallback.

Pane publication does no native I/O. It retains row handles/marks/focus only with a sealed successor for the same native basename, canonicalizes bound metadata, invalidates lost sources explicitly, and retains hidden-mark review.
Full-key row indexing supports mixed retained and newly allocated handles. Duplicate/hard-link native names remain separate source entries; no identity hash is assumed unique.
Held-observation model budget defaults to 1024 with maximum configuration 4096; over-budget publication preserves previous state. OS limits may fail earlier.

native_qualification.macos: APFS; stable-file metadata update and retained pane selection; same-name replacement while old object remains held; parent rename/replacement while child held; held parent already renamed before child observation; hard links and final dangling symlinks
native_qualification.linux: Lima ckdev Debian 13 arm64/ext4; same native fixtures as macOS through O_PATH child opens and held directory
native_qualification.windows: V: ReFS; stable-file metadata update and retained pane selection; same-name replacement while old object remains held; held parent already renamed before child observation; hard links and final junctions; classic parent rename with an open child refused with Win32 ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED 5, continuity retained after refusal, controlled fixture rename succeeds only after child observations leave scope

windows_parent_rename.state: Observed native limit, not a continuity implementation failure

windows_junction_fixture.correction: Create the link directory required by make_junction before setting its reparse point.

initial_standalone_sanitizer.correction: Add data_channels.cpp defining InventoryLimits::valid to the standalone link command. No production workaround.

limitations: Selection continuity under native identity semantics is not content stability, a frozen pathname-membership snapshot, preservation consent or mutation authority. Planner/engine revalidation remains mandatory.
Only exact native basenames through the same held parent continue. Case/normalization renames and unrelated independently opened observations do not automatically transfer marks.
Normal listing rows can remain unbound; such selections are still explicitly invalidated on refresh. Worker integration/handle scheduling and UI review remain to be implemented.

Retained handles can restrict native mutations, including the qualified Windows parent-directory rename limit. Production code must not silently close pins and retry; mutation plan/review/recovery semantics must account for the limit.
APFS/ext4/ReFS fixtures do not qualify arbitrary remote/virtual filesystems, unknown providers, hydration races or all resource-limit scenarios.

Out-of-core listings, remaining native inventories/provider coordination, destination collision/capability rules and full injected filesystem/time infrastructure remain WP-01 work. No Files GUI or mutation engine exists.
